cards.name: Everyday Cash
cards.summary: See how grocery and dining rewards can work, including eligibility conditions and category caps.
cards.plainEnglish: Cash-back cards return a portion of eligible purchases. The category where you shop can affect how much you earn.
cards.watchOut: Some issuers cap bonus rewards or exclude certain merchants, even when they sell groceries or food.
cards.limitations: Demo terms only: no actual rewards percentage, offer, APR or issuer agreement is represented.

cards.name: Open Skies
cards.summary: Understand points, airline redemption rules and which travel perks come with restrictions.
cards.plainEnglish: Travel cards may earn miles or points that can be used in different ways. Redemption value depends on program rules.
cards.watchOut: Award availability, transfer ratios, blackout policies and annual fees can affect the real value of rewards.
cards.limitations: Fictional program; no actual airline, points valuation or booking benefit is promised.

cards.name: Campus Compass
cards.summary: Explore student-card conditions and the rules that affect everyday dining and transit rewards.
cards.plainEnglish: Student cards may have eligibility requirements tied to enrollment or credit history, and rewards can vary by transaction type.
cards.watchOut: Being a student does not guarantee approval. Verify issuer eligibility requirements and any intro rate expiration.
cards.limitations: Demo only, with no actual student eligibility or rewards terms.

cards.name: Starter Secured
cards.summary: Learn how a refundable deposit may relate to credit limits, billing and possible upgrades.
cards.plainEnglish: A secured credit card usually requires a cash deposit that may help establish a credit line. It is not the same as a prepaid card.
cards.watchOut: Review whether the issuer reports to credit bureaus and the rules for refunds, upgrades, late fees and closure.
cards.limitations: This example does not specify an actual minimum deposit or credit eligibility rules.

cards.name: Online Plus
cards.summary: Decode online shopping categories, subscription credits and the limits behind bonus rewards.
cards.plainEnglish: Some card programs give extra rewards for qualifying digital purchases. What counts as online may vary by merchant coding.
cards.watchOut: Subscriptions and digital wallets may not always qualify; credits can require enrollment and expire.
cards.limitations: Fictional terms only, with no guaranteed digital-shopping coverage or reward rate.

cards.name: Everyday Points
cards.summary: Understand flexible points and how grocery, travel and entertainment spending may earn rewards.
cards.plainEnglish: Points programs can allow statement credits, travel or gift cards, but one point need not equal one cent for every redemption.
cards.watchOut: Check minimum redemption amounts, expiration policies and whether certain purchases earn base rather than bonus points.
cards.limitations: Fictional program; redemption options are explanatory examples and not an issuer promise.
